summary: Builds with no errors and no warnings under taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean (host node1). `lake build --no-build GXScaffold.Branched.Basic` reports all targets up to date, so nothing is waiting to be rebuilt. The file has 0 occurrences of 'sorry'. #print axioms, run through stdin so nothing was written, gives only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for complete_path_carac, branched_covering_restriction, subcovering_general, spread_connected_image, subcovering_portly, ordinary_part, isPortly_preimage, branching_locii and isBranchedCovering_id. No sorryAx comes in through the sibling GXScaffold.Spread.Completion either. Fidelity, label by label against l.988-1087. def:branched_covering: IsBranchedCovering has exactly the paper's fields: spread, complete in the sibling's IsCompleteSpread, which is the paper's l.903 definition (ends over closure(p X)), surjective, ConnectedSpace X and Y, ordX and ordY portly. The definition is satisfiable (isBranchedCovering_id), and branchingLocus, IsPossiblyBranchedOver and fiber match the text. rem:branching_locii: both loci are skeletal, closed and have empty interior. rem:ordinary_part: a surjective IsCoveringMap ordX -> ordY (DEC-40), plus connectedness of both loci as the justification says. lem:portly_preimage_branched: as stated. lem:complete_path_carac: the TFAE of all four items. X1 -> Y1 is read as MapsTo + IsCoveringMap + Surjective (DEC-40). (iii) keeps Q Hausdorff and locally connected, and (iv) is the paper's. The partial-lift reading (I -> X continuous on [0,1)) is equivalent to the paper's and is disclosed. (iii) is per-universe w, the theorem is universe-polymorphic, and this is disclosed. The standing hypotheses carried (T2 and loc. path-connected on X and Y, Y first countable) are all used. Y connected and surjectivity are derived, not assumed. Fox's extension corollary is built for homotopies and paths, with Q only locally connected, and is not assumed (DEC-23). (iv) => (ii) is built through the space of ends, using the sibling's completion. lem:branched_covering_restriction: U open preconnected (weaker), V a component via IsCompOf. The extra MapsTo argument is only a proof term that types the restriction; it is derivable (IsCompOf.mapsTo) and disclosed. cor:spread_connected_image: the open-map and p''V = U parts are both proved, with fewer hypotheses than the paper. cor:subcovering_portly and lem:subcovering_general: as stated, on subspace topologies through Set.restrictPreimage. No hypothesis is added, none is vacuous or circular, no definition trivialises its notion, and no structure field carries a conclusion. The nine marks are justified. The module docstring follows kb/0006: marks within the first 4000 characters, quotes, a hypothesis checklist, SCOPE and provenance. REPORT.json is honest: every listed decl exists, sorry_count is 0 and builds is true. Its two findings are real: Y connected is used but neither assumed nor argued in the paper's (iv) => (i), and the paper embeds X in a completion that need not exist. Only minor issues remain.
